title: 四百个小时的录像  (Four Hundred Hours of Footage)

segments.t: Moments later, Wang Er drops a mountain of binders and hard drives onto Bu Xiaogu's desk so she can prepare for next week's meeting with Chun Yuqiao. Listen first.
小谷，准备好和淳于乔开会。
现在吗？
下个星期的这个时候，我们要从现在就开始准备。
这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
你要全部研究清楚。
没有问题！
用不着了，下周你就死了。
下周我就死了？
待会儿你就知道了。
Let's break down each line. Wang Er walks over with Xiaogu's first real assignment.
小谷，准备好和淳于乔开会。
'Xiaogu, get ready to have a meeting with Chun Yuqiao.' Adding "hao" right after "zhunbei", 'prepare', shows the preparation is complete and solid — 'get fully ready'.
现在吗？
'Right now?' Dropping "ma" onto "xianzai", 'now', turns a single time word into a startled yes-or-no question.
下个星期的这个时候，我们要从现在就开始准备。
'This time next week — we need to start preparing right from now.' Notice how Chinese says 'next week' using "xiage xingqi", literally 'the downward week', while "cong xianzai" means 'from now'.
这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
'These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.' Conversational "haiyou" means 'and also' or 'plus', and "sibai" puts "si", 'four', before "bai", 'hundred'.
你要全部研究清楚。
'You need to study all of it thoroughly.' Putting "qingchu", 'clear', directly after "yanjiu", 'research' or 'study', expresses studying the material until every detail is clear.
没有问题！
'No problem at all!' Earlier we heard brisk "mei wenti"; keeping the full "meiyou" in "meiyou wenti" sounds extra emphatic and eager to impress a boss.
用不着了，下周你就死了。
'You will not need that drink anymore — next week you are dead.' Handy "yongbuzhao" means 'have no need for', and "xiazhou" is a brisk two-syllable way to say 'next week'.
下周我就死了？
'Next week I am dead?' Xiaogu only swaps "ni", 'you', to "wo", 'I', and raises her pitch — Mandarin often echoes a statement with rising intonation to ask an incredulous question.
待会儿你就知道了。

'In a little while you will find out.' Remember "daihuir" (often pronounced "daihuir" with fourth tone in the north) for 'in a moment', paired with "zhidao", 'know' or 'find out'. Now let's hear the whole assignment scene once more.
小谷，准备好和淳于乔开会。
现在吗？
下个星期的这个时候，我们要从现在就开始准备。
这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
你要全部研究清楚。
没有问题！
用不着了，下周你就死了。
下周我就死了？
待会儿你就知道了。
Xiaogu dives straight into four hundred hours of footage so she will be ready for next week's meeting. You learned "xianzai", two ways to say "next week", and "meiyou wenti".
下次见！
